summary_1line: Angada and the monkey search party despair after missing Sugriva’s deadline and debate starving to death or hiding rather than returning without news of Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: The exhausted monkeys sit beneath flowering Vindhya trees, staring anxiously at the vast roaring ocean before them.
Prince Angada, lion‑shouldered and solemn, addresses the gathered monkeys as they sit in despair on the seashore.
The troop of monkeys collapses to the ground in fear as they realize spring has arrived and their deadline has passed.
